resources.string: Word lists used for suggestions and corrections.

The keyboard ships with its dictionaries inside the app. A signed dictionary pack can replace them without reinstalling the app: download it in your browser (or from the project page), then import the file here. The pack is checked (NextGlyph signature, compatibility, checksums) before use; if anything is wrong, nothing changes. Resetting brings back the dictionaries bundled with the app. Nothing you type is ever sent anywhere.
Go back to the original dictionaries

Lets you look for a new dictionary pack from this screen.

Off by default. When on, the Search for an update button contacts GitHub, and only when you tap it: no background check, no schedule. Nothing personal and no identifier is sent, only the request for the public files. The downloaded pack is verified like an imported one.
